name: Tsang 2004: 25->11 ms CCW rotation, Thomas pulse at 1-ms points (gamma)
origin: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004 (Laurentian University), circumcerebral "Octopus" ring
summary: The one configuration of Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004 reported as effective: the 849-point Thomas pattern at 1-ms points, stepped counter-clockwise through eight coils around the head, 25 ms on the first coil and 2 ms less on each of the next seven (last 11 ms), for 5 min. The paper reports more 35 to 45 Hz power over frontal and occipital, but not parietal or temporal, regions in 11 people.
notes: Tsang 2004 ran six configurations of its frequency-modulated pattern, 5 min each in table order: 100 ms +10, 100 ms -10, 25 ms +2, 25 ms -2, 167 ms +20, 167 ms -20 (Table 1 p.4 [1186]). + means less time on each next solenoid ('+, for acceleration'); for the third, 'the successive durations changed between 25 ms and 11 ms' (p.5 [1187]). The pattern 'was composed of 849 points whose duration was set to 1 ms', with 1 ms between pulses (p.5 [1187]). The first solenoid was over the left frontal region and the eighth over the right prefrontal region (p.4 [1186]); each position was a film canister (3.5 x 5 cm) with two coils. This program plays the third configuration alone, with the published values: the 849-point table (US 6,234,953), 1-ms points, a 1-ms gap (0.85 s per burst) and 25 down to 11 ms per coil, counter-clockwise from Fp1 to Fp2. It has one coil per position, and the site names are this project's reading. persinger-tsang-2004-six-configurations runs all six in order. The paper gives 0.5 to 1.5 uT near the scalp (p.5 [1187]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT the scalp gets about 24 uT, 16 to 48 times the paper's value; about 0.04 uT matches it. Eleven people and one significant configuration of six. It was always the third, and the paper says a cumulative effect of the fixed order cannot be excluded (p.10 [1192]). The amplifier filters were set between 0.5 and 35 Hz for a 35 to 45 Hz measure (p.6 [1188]), and the EEG was sampled with the field on. Single lab, never independently replicated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated, eyes closed, in a quiet, dim room. To check the gamma claim, record EEG over frontal and occipital sites and take a 20-s sample 2.5 min in.
schedule: One 5-min exposure, as one configuration of the original; compare it with a blinded sham session on another day.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004, Power increases within the gamma range over the frontal and occipital regions during acute exposures to cerebrally counterclockwise rotating magnetic fields with specific derivatives of change, Int J Neurosci 114:1183-1193 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15370182/ ; Persinger, Koren & Tsang 2003, Percept Mot Skills 97:877-894 (six 5-min ring configurations, 1 microTesla range) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/14738355/ ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785-807 (20+2 notation; coil 1 left frontal, coil 8 right prefrontal) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Saroka 2016, PhD dissertation, Laurentian University (Cook 1999 rotated the Thomas pulse with "the Octopus") https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/server/api/core/bitstreams/be015982-0b0f-4c27-a031-797637c364e1/content ; Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger, US 6,234,953 B1, Table 1 (Thomas pulse point values) https://patents.google.com/patent/US6234953B1/en ; Buckner et al. 2015, PLoS ONE 10(4) (Thomas file: 849 points at 3 ms, 2.55 s per cycle) https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25875081 ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
